name: Love Live! ~After School Ends~
source: It's the last week of the semester at Uranohoshi Girls’ High School and EVERYBODY's graduating when the weeks up! Yeah, everybody, even Nico. It doesn't matter what school year you were in either, it's been decided that EVERYONE attending Uranohoshi will be graduating, even if they're a first year! To celebrate, the school has been invited on a senior trip to Idol City, but some suspect there's more to the sudden vacation than Miku and Mono are letting on. With only a week to prepare for their future after school ends, how will The Chikafag and Chika spend their final week as students?
translation: 这是浦之星女子高中学期的最后一周，几周后每个人都即将毕业！是的，每个人，甚至尼科。无论你在哪个学年，我们已经决定，就读浦之星的每个人都将毕业，即使他们是一年级！为了庆祝，学校受邀参加一次前往偶像城的高年级旅行，但有些人怀疑这个突然的假期比Miku和Mono透露的要多。放学后只有一周的时间为自己的未来做准备，Chikafag和Chika将如何度过学生时代的最后一周？
